episode_title: When AI stops chatting and starts doing
selected_story_title: Meta is pushing AI from drafting into doing
selection_reason: This is the biggest story because it marks a practical shift from AI as a writing helper to AI as a task helper. That changes how creators and small businesses approve work, manage permissions, and check output before anything is sent or scheduled.
first_spoken_line: The biggest shift in this weekend’s AI news is not that another model got better at talking. It is that AI is starting to do things.
